purpose: Implement a pure verified Studio Capability Profile over CORE-03A CapabilityCandidate facts so a normal artist can inspect host-native, N0TE-native, owned-tool, provider and guided strengths/gaps and resolve the same N0TEable job without host/brand marketing or installed-name inference becoming capability authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect truthful per-studio capability facts and gaps, then resolve a stable N0TEable job from those same facts without any host, route kind, installed brand or marketing label receiving semantic priority.
lineage.capability: Verified per-studio capability profile and truthful gap surface over host-neutral resolver facts

legacy_candidates: environment/capability profile semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: profile input order is normalized by stable candidate_id and repeated reads/resolution are deterministic
host_label is descriptive only and changing it cannot change candidate legitimacy, score or recommendation
brand and display_name do not change numeric score or break equal-score route ties
unverified installed-tool facts remain visible as unverified but are rejected by the CORE-03A resolver
route summaries expose represented capabilities and verified/unverified candidate identities without ranking route kinds
the same N0TEable job may resolve to different route kinds in different Studio profiles based only on explicit candidate facts and constraints
truthful gaps reuse CORE-03A UNAVAILABLE/rejection reason codes rather than inventing marketing copy or fallback capability
multi-job resolution is deterministic by stable job.id and duplicate job/candidate identities are rejected
profile construction, summaries, gaps and resolution create no persistence, provider call, host mutation, approval or external side effect
no DAW brand, provider brand or installed tool name can create capability evidence by itself
next_selection_rule: After CORE-03B evidence, reconcile and globally compare host-neutral Template/Recipe chassis, verified tool/environment discovery prerequisites, preserved CORE-02 Success Memory and any newly dependency-ready customer outcome. Do not select a DAW adapter merely because a Studio profile exists.
